seen_animation: a.png shows a line-drawn plant: about eleven long pointed leaves fanning up and out from one hub near the middle of the frame, a narrow rectangular pot or stem block under the hub, and two long trunk lines running from the hub down off the bottom edge. Across frames 1-16 the drawing stays in the same place and at the same size; the only changes are small shifts of the leaf tips (the right-hand leaves and the lower-left leaf move a few pixels) and a slight change in the weight of the short left trunk stroke under the hub. It reads as a plant held in place with its leaves swaying slightly.
seen_film: d.png is a low-angle shot looking up at a coconut palm against blue sky: the trunk rises from the bottom centre, a cluster of coconuts sits just below the crown, and fronds fill the whole frame. Across frames 1-16 the camera holds; the fronds move slightly in the wind (small shifts of the frond edges, mostly at the right and left edges) and nothing else happens.
named_subject: A palm-like plant (the doodle's potted plant with long pointed leaves) standing in for the coconut palm in the film.
evidence: f.png frames 1-37 show a held shot with only small frond sway; e.png frames 1-37 show the same: the drawing keeps one position and size, with leaf tips moving a few pixels between neighbouring frames (for example the right-hand leaf tips between e.png 12-14 and 26-28, the lower-left leaf between 20-22). g.png shows every third drawing stacked almost exactly on top of each other with no gaps, offsets or reversals, matching the film's static camera. No frame shows a pop, size change or doubled drawing. The plant's hub and trunk sit in the centre of the frame as the palm trunk does in the film, with leaves radiating to the frame edges as the fronds do. Judged from still frames only, not playback.
primary_gap: The leaf sway is so small that in still frames it is near the limit of visibility, so the animation may read as a held drawing rather than wind-moved fronds, and the crown hub sits around mid-frame while the film's coconut cluster and crown sit higher with the trunk filling the lower third.
closes_when: Consecutive frames show the outer leaf tips (especially the far right and far left leaves) moving a visibly larger, gradual back-and-forth amount in step with the film's frond sway, while the hub and trunk stay fixed.
protect: The doodle's own construction: long single-stroke pointed leaves meeting at one hub, the small pot rectangle with its uneven stroke ends, plain thin black lines with no added detail or shading; the locked position and size across all frames; the absence of jumps or redraws.
identity_gap: The drawing keeps c.png's leaves, hub and pot rectangle, but adds two long trunk lines running from the hub off the bottom edge, which turns the potted plant's container into a section of trunk; this is an acceptable adaptation to the palm but is an addition not present in the doodle.
